title: Solve exact equilibrium for small p
action: For p = 1..9 and m = 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, set up the force-balance equations for p free edge dislocations plus the fixed obstacle. Solve the system numerically to obtain the equilibrium positions x_i (with x_1 < x_2 < ... < x_p) and record the leading distance x1_p in dimensionless units (2σ/A)·x1_p. Write the values as an array of {p, m, x1_p} objects to /app/outputs/exact_x1_p.json.
description: Compute exact leading-dislocation distances for small numbers of free dislocations; these are the input to the scaling step.

title: Compute super-dislocation approximations and asymptotic formula
action: Load the exact x1_p values from exact_x1_p.json. For each (p, m), compute table1 entries (large n) as x1_approx = x1_p × (m + p), and for p=1,2,3 compute table2 entries (n=10) as x1_approx = x1_p × (m + p) / 10. Collect the asymptotic formula string "x1 = m(m+1)A/(nσ)". Write the three items into /app/outputs/results.json as an object with keys 'table1', 'table2', 'asymptotic_formula'.
description: Produce the paper's key approximate results: Table 1 columns 5‑7 (large n) and Table 2 (n=10), plus the asymptotic formula.
